text: Compensation [Lat. compensatio ]: Ger. Gegenforderung , Kompensation ; Fr. compensation ; Ital. compenso . In the civil law and in Scotch law: payment by a set-off. It is the exercise of the right of a defendant in an action, to whom the plaintiff is indebted, to offer to set his demand off against the plaintiff's demand, submitting to judgment only for the difference, if any, in favour of the plaintiff. 'Compensatio necessaria est, quia interest nostra potius non solvere quam solutum repetere' ( Dig ., xvi. 2, De Compensationibus , 3). ( S.E.B. )
